scope: English translations of selected user-authored project instructions. Ambient UI context and unrelated or private content are omitted. Original event hashes bind each selected source message; these are not translations of internal instructions or reasoning.

prompts.translation: Our Part 1 requirements must also be fully satisfied.

Provide the review page with motion trajectories now.
All pushed files must be in English; README and the site may additionally provide a switchable Chinese version.
Use Astra as the scoring VLM; keep the original participant models.
Prevent the computer from sleeping during execution until completion.
